externalSources.supports: Bolivia official Ruta del Vino y Singani: Tarija, Cintis, Potosí and altitude ~1700–2400 m; singani grape distillate.

La Paz tourism: salteña and plato paceño as representative traditional foods.
Official Potosí tourism: salteñas and region-specific cuisine.
